candidates.title: Longitudinal MRI-based deep learning model for predicting pathological complete response in breast cancer: a multicenter, retrospective cohort study
candidates.training_coverage: Official simplified release contains ResNet18+MHSA+LSTM, train/finetune and temporal permutation data scripts. Training protocol and tensor axes require repairs; not exact original training reproduction.
candidates.inputs: Peak DCE phase, ROI64x128x128, T0-T3 for temporal permutation pretraining; ResNet18+MHSA+LSTM; downstream clinical integration optional.
candidates.adaptation: Same-split observed-prefix variant; no test future MRI; reproduce temporal-order stage using development patients only.
candidates.notes: Official README explicitly calls release simplified. code_inventory audit found best_test checkpoint selection and test evaluation each epoch, validation/test drop_last=True, random file splits, hardcoded four visits; 2D MHSA input mixes patient axis, finetune channel mismatch, paper256d/8heads versus code512d/4heads. Reimplement paper method with correct temporal attention, patient-disjoint manifests and validation-only selection; do not reproduce leaked protocol.
candidates.license: README claims MIT, but no LICENSE file in root snapshot; do not automatically redistribute large code excerpts in public package.

candidates.training_coverage: Models, ART/TESSL losses, data loaders and pretraining training/validation engines present; no downstream pCR linear-evaluation script found in exact archive.
candidates.inputs: 585 ISPY2, four visits, early PE/late PE/SER 2D MIP; reconstruction+temporal continuity+responder alignment; frozen representation linear readout.
candidates.adaptation: Supplement linear readout and evaluate legal prefixes. Existing NPZs store raw cropped pre/firstpost/metadata_late intensities (normalization occurs in loader), providing a basis for PE/SER derivation, but original phase timing, denominator, clipping, units and MIP generation must be audited. Start with explicitly labeled matched three-phase-MIP input adaptation.
candidates.notes: Alignment uses training pCR labels; do not label it outcome-free SSL. README December2025 acknowledges sensitivity to loss weights and recommends tuning on new tasks.

candidates.training_coverage: Four source scripts include model.py,data_utils.py,train_test.py,main.py; main placeholders for JSON paths, split indices and checkpoint; import/environment adaptation required.
candidates.inputs: Whole-breast firstpost MRI80x256x256 at pre-NAC and post-NAC (our T0/T3), clinical age/race/HR/HER2/menopausal.
candidates.adaptation: Restrict to observed T0/T1/T2 histories, match available covariates and specify ROI-vs-whole-breast adaptation; original T3 model is not early-prediction baseline.
candidates.notes: Original I-SPY2 660, external I-SPY1 114. No treatment arms. Private data paths alone are routine adapter work, not absence of architecture.
candidates.license: No LICENSE file in complete archive.

candidates.title: Development and validation of an MRI spatiotemporal interaction model for early noninvasive prediction of neoadjuvant chemotherapy response in breast cancer: a multicentre study
candidates.training_coverage: Main, fivefold trainer, 3D ResNet, Siamese/temporal/habitat architecture and dataset present. No habitat segmentation generation or contrastive pretrain recipe/weights found.
candidates.inputs: Peak-enhancement DCE at baseline and early treatment; three-class tumor habitat masks; elapsed time; Siamese+temporal attention.
candidates.adaptation: Supply valid habitat masks/elapsed time; restrict T0-T1 or legal T0-T2 pair; preserve three habitats or label spatial-prior simplification; repair split-before-oversampling.
candidates.notes: Source device condition always selects CPU. Main oversamples before k-fold risking same-patient leakage. Masks pass through image preprocessing and must preserve integer labels. Do not run official pipeline blindly.
candidates.license: README claims MIT but full archive has no LICENSE file.

candidates.title: An explainable longitudinal multi-modal fusion model for predicting neoadjuvant therapy response in women with breast cancer
candidates.training_coverage: MRI+MG model, data loaders, run.py and Lightning training/test routines present. Official environment Python3.7/PyTorch1.8.1/Lightning1.5.9; private clinical schema and checkpoint paths.
candidates.inputs: MRI branch iMRrhpc: longitudinal subtraction MRI+stage embeddings+rhpc clinical factors; full MRP additionally mammography, unavailable in current task.
candidates.adaptation: Use MRI branch only, align observed prefixes and available pre-outcome covariates; cannot claim reproducing full mammography+MRI fusion MRP.
candidates.notes: Current dataset x_idx1 and x_idx2 both use date2; INB_COMPETITION_TASKS undefined; cfg.data.frac/transform mismatches. Fix/audit before training. Do not automatically use post-operative pathology columns as predictors.
